name: Matěj Janovský — wife Kateřina Votýpková and children Anna (1869) and František (1874), Malšice, Bohemia
researcher_question: Matěj Janovský, born about 1843, married Kateřina Votýpková at Malšice, Tábor, Bohemia on 27 October 1866. Who were his wife or wives, and which children were born to him?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 8, hint-samples.csv row 239, flags adds_spouse/adds_son, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-28 as outcome 2: the hinted 26 Jan 1874 Malšice baptism of Josef (father Matěj Janovský, mother Marie) belongs to a different Matěj Janovský, who married Marie Sokorová in 1871. The tree person's real children found are František (bp. 5 Oct 1874, image-confirmed) and Anna (bp. 18 May 1869, index-only, not required); f3 guards against the Marie/Josef over-claim.
